description: This file defines the Spanish (Peru) culture information for the DateJS library, including local names for days and months, date and time formats, regex patterns for parsing, and methods for date manipulation specific to the 'es-PE' locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of the date object to zero, effectively clearing the time part.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week based on its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.
